title: Certificate statement (v1)
description: A signed-JSON certificate — no X.509, no ASN.1. The root object is the wire form; `payload` is base64 of the exact signed bytes, which decode to a JSON object valid against `#/$defs/payload`. Certificates are signed directly by a root, so the envelope carries no chain.

payload.description: Decoded certificate statement. `format`/`formatVersion` domain-separate statement types so a signature over one type can never be replayed as another.

publicKey.description: base64 of the raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key being certified.

validFrom.description: Unix time in seconds, UTC. A bundle whose signedAt predates its signer's validFrom does not verify.

ed25519Signature.description: base64 of a raw 64-byte Ed25519 signature.

keyId.description: Opaque unique key identifier assigned when the key is minted (e.g. `root-1`, `intermediate-2026-07`).
